decisions.reason: This illuminated candle arch remains close enough to the firm's craft-based knowledge base that management can learn from past market experience and refine it without needing capabilities far beyond its established workshop routines.

The one-tier Christmas pyramid sits squarely in the firm's traditional competence set, and in a growing market for seasonal wooden décor it is a product the firm can continue to support and improve with high absorptive capacity.

As an accessory linked to the discontinued electronic music box platform, this product draws on knowledge that is relatively distant from the firm's core and offers limited scope for further learning or commercial improvement within the existing business.

The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's long-developed design and production know-how, so management is likely to retain it as a differentiated variation within the established assortment.
